title: 红灯停，绿灯行
subtitle: 过马路，我会看一看
character: wearing a bright yellow t-shirt, navy shorts, white sneakers and a small blue backpack, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, risograph print on off-white paper, grainy speckled ink texture with slight colour misregistration, flat bold shapes, bright red, yellow, blue and green inks, every person has natural skin tones, signs and cars without any writing
facts: 先看看左右，没有车再走
马上要变红灯了，不要抢
司机看不到小朋友，要离远一点

pages.zh:
早上，爸爸送我去幼儿园。
马路上的车好多好多，
嘀嘀，嘟嘟，开得好快。
我紧紧牵着爸爸的手。
pages.scene: Morning on a city sidewalk: the little boy holds his father's hand tightly as they walk along, the father is a grown adult man in a grey jacket, cars driving past on the busy street beside them.

pages.zh:
路口有一个三只眼睛的灯，
红的、黄的、绿的。
它叫「红绿灯」，
是马路上的指挥员。
pages.scene: Close view of one traffic light on a pole, the traffic light fills most of the picture: three round lamps stacked with red at the top, yellow in the middle and green at the bottom, the red lamp glowing brightly, a clear blue sky behind it and an empty quiet street corner below.

pages.zh:
红灯亮了，
车子都停下来，
我们也要停下来，
站在路边等一等。
pages.scene: At a crossroads the traffic light glows red at the top, and a neat row of cars has stopped before the white stripes of an empty zebra crossing, a calm street.

pages.zh:
绿灯亮了！
我和爸爸走上斑马线，
白白的一道，又一道，
我们一起走过去。
pages.scene: A traffic light on a pole with its bottom green light glowing and the red and yellow lights above it dark. The little boy and his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair and natural skin, in a grey jacket and dark trousers, walk across a zebra crossing holding hands, the white stripes on the grey road under their feet, cars waiting behind the line.

pages.zh:
过马路前，还要看一看：
左边看看，右边看看，
没有车开过来，
再走。
pages.scene: The little boy stands at the edge of the sidewalk holding the hand of his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair and natural skin, in a grey jacket and dark trousers, turning his head to look carefully to the left along the empty street before crossing.

pages.zh:
黄灯一闪一闪，
是在说：
「马上要变红灯啦，
不要抢，慢慢来。」
pages.scene: A traffic light above a street corner with its yellow middle light glowing and the red and green lights dark, cars slowing down gently, evening light, an empty sidewalk.

pages.zh:
大卡车好高好高，
司机叔叔坐在上面，
看不见车子旁边的小朋友。
pages.scene: A big delivery truck with a tall cab parked beside the road, a grown-up driver with a mustache sitting high up in the cab, plain truck sides, and a wide empty space on the ground next to the big front wheel.

pages.zh:
所以我不在车子旁边玩，
也不从停着的车后面跑出来。
我的小皮球，
等到了公园再玩。
pages.scene: The little boy stands on the sidewalk well away from the parked cars, holding a red ball in both hands, his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair and natural skin, in a grey jacket and dark trousers, standing beside him, a safe quiet street.

pages.zh:
路口还有交通警察叔叔，
他戴着白手套，
手一抬，车子就停；
手一挥，车子就走。
pages.scene: A traffic police officer in a neat uniform and white gloves stands at the center of a crossroads raising one hand, the cars around him stopped and waiting; the officer is the only person in the picture.

pages.zh:
放学啦。
我按下路口的按钮，
等呀等，绿灯亮了——
左边看看，右边看看，
牵着爸爸的手，走过斑马线。
pages.scene: Afternoon at a crosswalk: the little boy presses the round button on the traffic light pole with one finger while holding the hand of his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair and natural skin, in a grey jacket and dark trousers, waiting for the green light, smiling.
